effects.display_name: Guardian staged bullet motion, damage and Levitation
effects.actual_behavior: Both uppercut goals call Bulletpattern; with target at animationTick54 it creates9 owned bullets (i=-4..4), staging near floored target X/Z at targetY+0.1 (minus1 only if airborne, not in water and unsupported). Cardinal direction comes from boss/target block X/Z. Native delay30 stages velocity=(start-current)/remainingTimer; when timer<=0 first sets fired=true, velocity0 and timer30. Fired server ticks add dir*0.1 only while velocity²<=16; later timeout discards. It overrides tick without super.tick and uses move-vector collision, inherited canHitEntity and posted/cancellable projectile impact. Unfired impacts do not deliver payload/discard. Fired impact discards regardless of hurt/effect success. Fired hurt callback server-discard returns true; unfired hurt returns true without discard; canBeCollidedWith=false.

effects.display_name: Guardian death callback and native respawner linkage
effects.actual_behavior: Reuses shared cancelled/credited death callback admission. Guardian getDeathAnimation returns FALLEN196; shared LLibrary duration is196-20=176. onDeathAIUpdate calls super then zeroes horizontal motion retaining Y. AfterDefeatBoss with configured respawner=true, server, existing home and resolvable home dimension invokes Respawner at home X/Z with searchY homeY..homeY-10. Native code reads support/collision from current boss level but writes target home level; places BOSS_RESPAWNER with update flag2 even if no support (fallback maxY). Stores ENDER_GUARDIAN type and VOID_EYE requirement. Matching native item use lights block/consumes1; nearby alive player radius9, LIT, nonpeaceful server and animation counter>=19 attempt spawn. Native spawn finalizes SPAWNER and sets home; destroys respawner only on successful addFreshEntity. It does not call setUsedMassDestruction(false), so fresh Guardian retains the locked used=true default unlike altar spawn.

effects.display_name: Guardian vortex pull and terminal native explosion
effects.actual_behavior: BLACKHOLE goal tick26 with target searches sturdy support under target X/Z between min(targetY,bossY) and max+1; on support creates Guardian-owned Void_Vortex lifespan300. Native tick, without local side guard, pulls while min(tickCount,currentLifespan)>=16 in AABB X/Z ±3,Y[0,15]. Exclude vortex allies, current cached owner/owner allies and Player invulnerable ability; velocity += (0,-2,0)-normalize(recipientPos-vortexPos)*0.075. Lifespan decrements each tick; <=0 invokes Level.explode(owner,power2,fire=false,NONE) then discards. No ally predicate surrounds the terminal native explosion. Fresh owner is Guardian: native direct/causing explosion actors are Guardian, not vortex; literal player_explosion is selected despite nonplayer owner. Saved CasterId is runtime integer, not UUID. Server tick directly reads owner and does not call getOwner; after ordinary load it may remain null, changing pull exclusions and explosion actors/type to ownerless explosion.
